method.screen: scripts/rex_corpus_c/identify.mjs over 76 read-only corpus members; identity from first-party in-ROM ASCII banners only
not_used: vgmrips/GMIC catalog labels as local evidence
method.corpus_note: Every donor in this corpus comes from a translated (PtBr) zip, a homebrew build or an Unl dump; no pristine commercial dump was available locally. `Sonic the Hedgehog (USA, Europe).bin` is 531577 B with appended non-ROM bytes and `Aladdin (USA).bin` fails its own SEGA checksum, so both were excluded rather than repaired.

selected.why_reserved: declared before tuning, and different driver version plus different ROM, so it tests generalisation rather than recall

selected.why_not_selected: no byte-level documentation exists for Mucom-MD in any source found, and reconstructing its chain was out of budget for one front; recorded as follow-up

phase1_correction.claim_retired: no SMPS ROM exists in this local corpus
phase1_correction.why_it_was_wrong: the screen keyed on ASCII banners, but SMPS-Z80 drivers publish no version string in ROM; banner-only detection is necessary and not sufficient
phase1_correction.evidence: Mega Man - The Wily Wars (Europe).gen at 0x1e505a contains Z80 code 2a 02 1c (ld hl,($1C02)), the SMPS comm-queue data-start word; container sha-256 b9e41127281edbfc16b680d99d8187234c00b0e7c4cd4182d8a93aface9a0787, 2102230 B
phase1_correction.consequence: SMPS-Z80 remains an open front with a pinnable first-party spec; the Ancient profile delivered here does not depend on this claim

invariants_observed_across_both_ancient_: 8 KiB Z80 image copied to $a00000 with `move.w #$1fff,d0` and byte-by-byte (a1)+/(a2)+ loop
song index read as `andi.w #$ff,d0 / lsl.w #$2,d0 / move.l (a0,d0.w),d1 / adda.l d1,a0`
stream dispatch prologue `movea.l $2(a6),a0 / moveq #$0,d2 / move.b (a0)+,d2 / cmpi.b #$f0,d2 / bcc / tst.b d2 / bne / bclr.b #$7,d2`, three instances in each ROM
index values strictly increasing; 177 used slots in v1.06, 128 in v1.00
